data.name: Muyassir
data.gender_notes: Muyassir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'wsr', meaning 'to pass over, surpass, or exceed'. This name signifies someone who has achieved great success and victory in their life, often through their intelligence, wisdom, and courage. The name Muyassir carries the meaning “Successful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muyassir usually hope their child will grow to embody successful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
